georgia-law (public on GitHub, pinned 9c5cdcb = main) holds all 948 documents of Matsne's 'law' group (507 in force), including the 1995 Constitution in its 2017/2018 form and every essential code, as consolidated texts with dated in-force history to 2026-10-26; the Labour Code spot check matches Matsne's newest version (16/09/2026). But 54 laws Matsne marks expired are still in the current tree (among them the 1997 Civil Service Law, the 2004 Parliament Rules and the 2011 Electoral Code), about 150 never-amended laws end with Matsne's site footer, sub-laws are not held (Matsne's consolidations of them are paid: confirmed), and no case law is held.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
